lyrics:
Sing praises to the living God, Glory hallelujah
Come, adore the living God, Glory hallelujah
Though sun and moon may pass away, His word will ever stay
His power is for evermore, Glory hallelujah

Ch: Glory to the Trinity
The undivided Unity
The Father, Son and Spirit One
From whom all life and goodness come

To the living God we sing, Glory hallelujah
Let our love and praises ring, Glory hallelujah
To His sons He always gives, His mercy and His love
Praise Him now for evermore, Glory hallelujah

To the Lord who cannot die, Glory hallelujah
To the living God we cry, Glory hallelujah
He promised to be with us, and He lives in everyone
Love Him now for evermore, Glory hallelujah
